caption: The drawing depicts a single bowl with an octagonal, fluted rim, placed almost centrally within a rectangular frame. The bowl is illustrated in a realistic style and colored in tones of beige and light brown, with accents of muted green and reddish-brown streaks that mimic the appearance of marble or veined stone. Shading is used to suggest the bowl’s depth and curvature, with darker tones on the inner folds and base, and lighter tones on the surfaces that catch more light. The bowl sits on a slightly raised round foot, and its wide, shallow body flares outward toward the rim, which features geometric, angular edges. In the bottom left corner of the outer frame, the name "R. Tumagalli" is inscribed. The background is plain, with the object occupying the majority of the space within the inner border drawn in fine lines.
title: Wash Bowl
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
